'''Arakato-be''' (あらかとべ, dates unknown) was an ancient Japanese noble and a member of the {{ill|Kii no Kuni no Miyatsuko|ja|紀国造|lt=Ki no Kuni no Miyatsuko}} lineage.
== Overview ==
In the {{ill|Kojiki|ace|Kojiki|ar|كوجيكي|az|Kociki|bcl|Kojiki|be|Кодзікі|bg|Коджики|ca|Kojiki|ckb|کۆجیکی|cs|Kodžiki|da|Kojiki|de|Kojiki|eo|Koĝiki|es|Kojiki|et|Kojiki|eu|Kojiki|fa|کوجیکی|fi|Kojiki|fr|Kojiki|gl|Kojiki|he|קוג'יקי|hi|कोजिकी|hr|Kojiki|hu|Kodzsiki|hy|Կոձիկի|id|Kojiki|it|Kojiki|ja|古事記|ka|კოძიკი|kk|Кодзики|kn|ಕೋಜಿಕಿ|ko|고사기|la|Kojiki|lt|Kodžiki|mk|Коџики|ml|കൊജികി|ms|Kojiki|my|ခိုဂျိခိ|nl|Kojiki|no|Kojiki|oc|Kojiki|pl|Kojiki|pt|Kojiki|ro|Kojiki|rsk|Кодїки|ru|Кодзики|sh|Kojiki|simple|Kojiki|sk|Kodžiki|sl|Kodžiki|sr|Коџики|sv|Kojiki|ta|கோஜிகி|th|โคจิกิ|tl|Kojiki|tr|Kojiki|uk|Кодзікі|vi|Cổ sự ký|zh|古事記|zh_classical|古事記|qid=Q813031|lt=Kojiki}}, she is referred to as '''Ki no Kuni no Miyatsuko Arakato-be-no-Mikoto''' or simply '''Arakato-be-no-Mikoto'''. In the {{ill|Kujiki|en|Kujiki|qid=Q2716751|lt=Sendai Kuji Hongi}} "Tenson Hongi" section, she is called '''Kii Arakato-be'''. Genealogical records also use the name '''Arakato-be-no-Mikoto'''.
Arakato-be is described as the fourth or fifth-generation descendant of {{ill|Amanomichine|fr|Amanomichine|ja|天道根命|simple|Amanomichine|zh|天道根命|qid=Q10940767}}. Her children include {{ill|Michishimamato no Mikoto|ja|美智支真止乃命}} and {{ill|Tōtsu Ayume Maguwashi Hime|ja|遠津年魚眼眼妙媛}}, the consort of {{ill|Emperor Sujin|en|Emperor Sujin|qid=Q333530|lt=Emperor Sujin}}.<ref>{{ill|Nakata Norinobu|ja|中田憲信|qid=Q140447354}}, "Mochizuki," in ''Shokeifu'', Volume 4.</ref> In the "Tenson Hongi," her daughter {{ill|Nakatsuhime|ja|中日女}} is identified as the wife of {{ill|Ōaragawa no Mikoto|ja|大新河命}}, an ancestor of the {{ill|Tōtomi no Kuni no Miyatsuko|ja|遠淡海国造}}, {{ill|Kuno no Kuni no Miyatsuko|ja|久努国造}}, and other clans such as the {{ill|Yatabe no Muraji|ja|矢田部氏}} and {{ill|Yatsudō no Muraji|ja|矢集氏}}.
